definitions.gloss: resident bird; non-migratory bird; sedentary bird
definitions.explanation: A bird species that remains in the same area year-round without migrating.

examples.japanese: スズメは{日本|にほん}の{代表的|だいひょうてき}な{留鳥|りゅうちょう}だ。
examples.english: Sparrows are a typical resident bird in Japan.

examples.japanese: この{公園|こうえん}では{留鳥|りゅうちょう}を{一年中|いちねんじゅう}{観察|かんさつ}できる。
examples.english: You can observe resident birds in this park all year round.

examples.japanese: カラスやハトは{都市部|としぶ}でもよく{見|み}られる{留鳥|りゅうちょう}である。
examples.english: Crows and pigeons are resident birds commonly seen even in urban areas.

notes:
{留鳥|りゅうちょう} refers to bird species that stay in one region throughout the year, as opposed to {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり} (migratory birds). In Japan, common examples include スズメ (sparrow), カラス (crow), ハト (pigeon), メジロ (white-eye), and キジ (pheasant).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {留鳥|りゅうちょう}として{分類|ぶんるい}される — to be classified as a resident bird
- {留鳥|りゅうちょう}の{個体数|こたいすう} — population of resident birds
- {留鳥|りゅうちょう}の{生態|せいたい} — ecology of resident birds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり} — migratory bird (moves between regions with seasons)
- {漂鳥|ひょうちょう} — wandering bird (moves locally within a country by altitude or latitude)
- {迷鳥|めいちょう} — vagrant bird (arrives outside its normal range by accident)
